notes: Five schema-valid adapter FOMs exercise the variant-record Discriminant Type category at public Create Federation Execution. An enumerated type and an omitted incomplete row are accepted; separate raw basic-data, simple-data, and NA discriminants are rejected as InconsistentFOM. Each alternative uses the standard HLAboolean data type so the rejected branch isolates the discriminant. This does not claim enumerator membership, ranges, overlap, Java provider runtime, interoperability, or conformance.
